newsitem.title: USA: Goldman to buy Liberty Investment.
newsitem.headline: Goldman to buy Liberty Investment.

text.p: Goldman Sachs & Co. said Thursday it reached an agreement to acquire Liberty Investment Management, a Tampa, Fla.-based investment advisory firm with $5.4 billion in assets under management.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.
The investment banking firm said Liberty Investment will merge into its Goldman Sachs Asset Management division.
Goldman said Liberty's owner and Chief Executive Herbert Ehlers agreed to invest "a significant portion of his transaction proceeds" into the firm's Active Equity products.
The deal was also structured to include long-term employment agreements for each of Liberty's investment professionals, Goldman said.
Goldman said it expected to close the deal in January.
